statement: No SPI colour read at 0x6050..0x605B or explicit reaction to an all-0xFF colour block is evidenced in the inspected Linux hid-nintendo or SDL 3.2.0 Switch HIDAPI initialization paths, even when device-info advertises colours in SPI.

applicability.revision: dekuNukem b354f21 / Linux 4056b3c / SDL 535d80b / OpenPuck 29f4d1e (as cited); retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Source silence: hid-nintendo.c 2477-2637 and SDL_hidapi_switch.c 629-684, 936-1090, 1457-1567. Device-info colour flag semantics come from community source, not validated host read. No evidence, not proof of absence in all consumers.
